title: ALT (alanine aminotransferase)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: ALT is an enzyme found mainly in the liver. Blood usually contains low levels of it. It is often measured together with other liver tests to help check the liver.
context: Many things can affect ALT results, including age, sex, weight, medicines and supplements. A result outside the reported range does not always mean there is a condition that needs treatment.
aboveRange: Irritation or inflammation of liver cells, from several possible causes
Reduced blood flow to the liver
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
